manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick up the brown sauce can with top lid and set it beside the cylindrical kitchenpot for cooking

Task description: Move the brown condiment jar with a light-colored lid on the right of the current view to the light-colored cylindrical cooking pot in the center, placing it on the pot's right side.

Success criteria: Stand the sauce jar on the tabletop immediately to the right of the cooking pot, approximately aligned front to back, with the bottom supported and no suspension. Both grippers must be open and the jar released.

## Execution tips

- Grasp relatively straight opposing sides in the middle of the can, avoiding the projecting lid rim and narrowed shoulder. Open slightly wider than that body section and confirm both fingers surround the sidewall before closing, avoiding one-sided pushing or a lid-only grasp.
- Near the kitchen pot, leave room for the fingers on the pot-facing side to descend and withdraw, avoiding contact with the pot wall that could tilt the can.
- Lower the jar base slowly during placement and release after confirming the table supports it. Withdraw in a direction clear of the jar body and pot wall to avoid tipping it over.
